chapterTitle: Chapter 2 Polar Covalent Bonds; Acids and Bases
title: Problem 2-10

pages.text: PROBLEM 2-10 Draw the indicated number of resonance forms for each of the following substances: (a) The methyl phosphate anion, CH3OPO32– (3) (b) The nitrate anion, NO3– (3) (c) The allyl cation, H2C CH–CH2+ (2) (d) The benzoate anion (2)
